```plato
	// https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Epicycloid
	// x = (R+r)cos t - r cos((R+r)/r t); y = (R+r)sin t - r sin((R+r)/r t)
	Epicycloid(t: Angle, R: Number, r: Number): Point2D
		=> ((R + r) * t.Cos - r * ((R + r) / r * t).Cos,
			(R + r) * t.Sin - r * ((R + r) / r * t).Sin);
```
